blocks.title: Solids
blocks.text: Solids are those substances which are rigid, hard, have definite shape and definite volume.
The atoms, ions and molecules that make up a solid are closely packed. They are held together by strong cohesive forces. The constituent atoms, ions or molecules of solids cannot move at random.
